item.title: Richard Scolyer, renowned cancer researcher, dies at 59
item.description:
Prof Richard Scolyer, a world-renowned cancer researcher and melanoma expert, has died at 59. He was recognized as the former Australian of the year for his pioneering work in immunotherapy. Scolyer had been diagnosed with inoperable brain cancer in 2023.

item.description:

item.title: Triple-Action Diabetes Jab Reduces Weight and Blood Sugar
item.description:
Phase 3 trials show a new weekly drug, Retatrutide, significantly reduces blood sugar and body weight in type 2 diabetes patients. Participants lost over four times the weight of the placebo group and saw a greater drop in long-term blood sugar levels.

item.title: Ancient Chinese medicine shows potential for hair loss treatment
item.description:
Researchers are studying the traditional Chinese medicinal root, Polygonum multiflorum, for its ability to treat hair loss. Studies indicate the herb can block hormones, stimulate hair growth, and improve scalp blood flow. The findings suggest the herb's effects align with both ancient knowledge and modern biology.

item.title: Scientists complete 100-year-old color theory
item.description:
Researchers resolved a key problem in a century-old color theory, demonstrating that perceived color qualities are intrinsic to color space mathematics. This discovery enhances understanding of human vision and promises more precise color technologies and visualizations.
